state.show.help: Print the state of a run (the latest one by default).
state.list.help: List the runs recorded under the state directory.
state.drift.help: Compare a recorded run with the real repository.
state.arg.run: Run id. Defaults to the most recently written run.
state.drift.no_root: No repository root is recorded for this run, so git state and files were not checked.
state.drift.no_snapshot: The run has no recorded repository snapshot, so HEAD, branch and dirty files could not be compared.
state.drift.repo_unavailable: The recorded repository at {root} could not be read with git now.
state.drift.new_dirty: {count} file(s) are modified now that were clean when the run was recorded.
state.drift.missing_files: {count} file(s) reported as changed by tasks no longer exist.
state.drift.outside_root: Reported files outside the repository root were not checked: {files}.
state.drift.stale_running: Tasks recorded as running must be verified again, not assumed finished: {tasks}.
state.error.lock_timeout: Another wev process held the lock on {path} for more than {seconds} seconds. Nothing was changed; retry, and if it keeps happening check for a stuck wev process.
